chung.Syllabus Name: Dynamic Public Speaking_Nghệ thuật Diễn thuyết trước công chúng
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 62h online + 3h offline + 1h Final exam + 84 self-study
chung.Description:
This course is designed for speakers at all levels, especially those who feel nervous about public speaking. Through gradual, hands-on practice, learners build confidence and master key speaking skills before delivering full speeches. Students will learn the basics of public speaking and how to communicate effectively in different contexts: explaining complex ideas clearly with engaging slides, persuading audiences with strong arguments and impactful language, and inspiring listeners through ceremonial and motivational speeches.

In the applied learning project, learners design, practice, record, and receive feedback on speeches they can use in real-life situations. By the end of the course, they will be able to create compelling presentations and develop a portfolio of polished speeches.
chung.StudentTasks:
1. Join the online course(s) when being invited by the admin.

2. Enroll in the courses, regularly study the course at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required

3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct

4. Keep up with online learning progress (bonus will be awarded)

5. Communicate and discuss in forum

6. Attend offline sessions in the Campus (Optional)

7. Must complete the course(s) with certification(s) in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
chung.Note:
1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

2) Theoretical Exam (TE)

3) Final Result (FR) = min (10, TE + Bonus)

4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5
